centralDependencyQuestion: How did one tripped line cascade into a blackout for nearly seven million people?

evidence.claim: The blackout left nearly seven million people without power, including 1.4 million customers in San Diego County and 1.1 million customers in Mexico.
It occurred on Thursday, September 8, 2011, beginning at about 3:38pm PDT, and was the largest power failure in California history.
Grid managers maintain stability through the n-1 criterion: the system should remain within operating limits even if a single component fails.
CAISO incorrectly believed that it would have 30 mins to react in the event of a Path 44 overload.
